newsitem.title: JAPAN: JGBs end Tokyo down, profit-taking caps topside.
newsitem.headline: JGBs end Tokyo down, profit-taking caps topside.

text.p: * Key December 10-year JGBs ended easier as topside capped by profit-taking in cash bonds. The last-minute fall was due to rolling over shorts from the September by dealers.
* Earlier, the market rallied on weak economic data released late on Friday and falls in Tokyo stocks.
